contests.title: Sheboygan Falls School District — School facility improvement borrowing

measures.questionText: Shall the School District of Sheboygan Falls, Sheboygan County, Wisconsin be authorized to issue pursuant to Chapter 67 of the Wisconsin Statutes, general obligation bonds in an amount not to exceed $65,700,000 for the public purpose of paying the cost of a school facility improvement project consisting of: - renovations and updates at the Elementary School, including to special education and classroom spaces, the media center and cafeteria/kitchen; - construction of additions and renovations at the High School for science classrooms and labs, career and technical education, a science, technology, engineering and math lab, the media center and weight room/fitness area; - renovations and updates at the High School, including to special education and classroom spaces, the locker rooms, existing gymnasium and auditorium; - district-wide accessibility, safety, security and site improvements; - other capital projects identified in the District's capital improvement plan; and - acquisition of furnishings, fixtures and equipment?

provenance.quote: Shall the School District of Sheboygan Falls, Sheboygan County, Wisconsin be authorized to issue pursuant to Chapter 67 of the Wisconsin Statutes, general obligation bonds in an amount not to exceed $65,700,000 for the public purpose of paying the cost of a school facility improvement project consisting of: - renovations and updates at the Elementary School, including to special education and classroom spaces, the media center and cafeteria/kitchen; - construction of additions and renovations at the High School for science classrooms and labs, career and technical education, a science, technology, engineering and math lab, the media center and weight room/fitness area; - renovations and updates at the High School, including to special education and classroom spaces, the locker rooms, existing gymnasium and auditorium; - district-wide accessibility, safety, security and site improvements; - other capital projects identified in the District's capital improvement plan; and - acquisition of furnishings, fixtures and equipment?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Allow the district to borrow up to $65.7 million through general obligation bonds for Elementary School special-education and classroom, media-center and cafeteria/kitchen renovations; High School additions and renovations for science classrooms and labs, career and technical education, a STEM lab, the media center and fitness space; other High School classroom, special-education, locker-room, gym and auditorium updates; district-wide accessibility, safety, security and site improvements; other projects in the capital improvement plan; and furnishings, fixtures and equipment.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Authorize up to $65.7 million in borrowing for those school facility improvements.
